turns.instruction: Build M-INT-034 from attachment A: a 16 m, four-panel, 2.4 m-high truss. Report signed Ux and Uz at T2 at x=8 m on the top chord, left support B0 reactions Fx and Fz, and axial force N in the first bottom chord BC0. Include the node/member ID, position, global direction or axial tension/compression sign, m or kN units, load case D and current turn for every result. Use positive N for tension. Use a fresh OpenSees run after each physical change and retain its input, version, settings, successful log, raw-result mapping. Ask about unresolved essential input before reporting numerical results.

Use attachment B to replace the diagonal in panels x=4..8 m and x=8..12 m. Delete the old endpoints and use the replacement endpoints under the same IDs; retain exactly one diagonal per panel. All other connections, loads, supports and section groups remain unchanged.
